text:
Ivy: quick design review notes from today's console walkthrough — bulk key upload + rotate/revoke UX. Short thread.

Jon: drop the repro steps pls?

Ivy: repro: Console > Credentials > Bulk create -> upload CSV -> Submit. Observed: modal closes immediately, toast says 'Batch created' and disappears. No permanent place to retrieve raw keys. Also keyboard focus ends up after the table header.

Priya: saw this too. On Mac VoiceOver the readout says 'modal closed' then focus lands on the search input, not the new keys.

Ivy: other issues: copy inconsistent with single-key flow. We have 'Save this secret now' in one place and 'Shown only once' elsewhere. Pick a single canonical phrasing.

designbot: Automated lint: copy consistency rule violated in file credentials/bulk-flow.tsx line 142.

Ivy: suggestion: after submit keep a pinned confirmation drawer/dialog that lists each generated key (masked except reveal button) plus a clear 'Download CSV' CTA and a required checkbox 'I have stored these keys' before dismiss. That matches compliance expectations.

Jon: important: avoid leaking keys in audit logs. The audit event should reference key IDs only. @infra?

Asha: infra: acknowledged. We'll ensure audit entries contain key_id and not plaintext. Need product to confirm required fields in audit.

Priya: accessibility: dialog must trap focus, aria-modal, and we should provide sr-only: 'N keys created. Keys shown only once.' Also keyboard focusable 'Download CSV' before list.

Ivy: RBAC case: if a user hits bulk create without permission currently we show generic 'you cannot do that'. We should show which permission is missing and a link to request access. e.g., "Missing permission: credentials.create:bulk".

Jon: good call. Also include the grantable role names in the message for admins.

QA-bot: e2e failed on PR #5120: bulk-create-keyboard-trap. See CI: https://ci.redwood/org/5120.

Priya: one more backend edge: CSVs with mixed empty expiry formats fail silently. Need preflight validator that returns row-level errors.

Ivy: yes — UI should surface per-row validation with inline errors and allow exporting a 'failed-rows.csv' for customers to fix and re-upload.

Tom: support note request: can someone draft a KB on bulk create expectations, "shown only once" policy, and rotation/revoke guidance? I'll add common customer questions.

Ivy: sample CSV snippet to show in help: ```email,role,expires_at,env
svc-a@org.com,reader,2026-01-01,prod
svc-b@org.com,writer,,staging
```

Jon: UI detail: if we show a long list in the confirmation use a fixed height with internal scroll, sticky header with download + copy-all buttons. Keyboard nav should hit CTA before list content.

Priya: also add contrast-safe highlight for failed rows and aria-describedby linking to the row error text.

Ivy: revoke flow UX: when revoking many keys, we should batch the action and show a progress modal with counts (revoked, failed). Allow 'undo' for 30s for accidental revokes. But audit must record immediate revoke for security — UI undo would submit a re-create request, not delete the audit. Call that out in copy.

Asha: security note: undo that recreates keys must mark them as new and not reuse old secrets. Also requires admin permission.

Jon: microcopy proposal for confirmation header: "Download these keys now 14 they will not be shown again." Secondary: "We will only display these secrets once. Save them securely or download a CSV."

Ivy: prefer exact short sentence: "These keys are visible only once. Download them now." Keep consistent with single-key text.

designbot: UX checklist reminder: color contrast, focus order, keyboardable CTAs, sr-only announcements, error-export button, per-row copy buttons.

Priya: can we add optional 'labels' column in CSV so customers can attach metadata (env/team)? Show mapping step in upload wizard to let them map CSV columns to internal fields.

Ivy: yes — show mapping, preview first 10 rows, and validate server-side for full file. Limit preview to 200 rows.

Tom: I'll draft KB and link to this thread. Also capture recommended support responses for lost keys: rotate and revoke vs re-creating.

Ivy: action items: Jon mock sticky header + download CTA; Priya add a11y annotations and SR text; Asha confirm audit payload; QA-bot to add e2e for focus trapping; Tom drafts KB. Sync tomorrow 10am. :calendar:
